description: List the real files inside an exact or resolvable package version via UNPKG ?meta. Use this before choosing a file path; never guess paths.

limit.description: Max files to return. Defaults to 200.

path.description: Directory prefix inside the package, e.g. /dist/. Defaults to /.

version.description: Defaults to latest; resolved before listing.

name: list_files
title: List files in a package version
